meta.title: Lingo - In-Game Chat Translation | Type in your language, the whole team reads it
meta.description: Lingo is an AI in-game chat translation client for Windows and macOS. Type normally in the chat box, press one hotkey, and the translation replaces your text in place. Built-in glossaries for Dota 2, League of Legends, Overwatch and World of Warcraft, 9 languages, free with no sign-up.
meta.keywords: game chat translation, in-game translator, AI game translator, hotkey translation, Dota 2 translator, League of Legends translator, Overwatch translator, World of Warcraft translator, team chat translation, game glossary

hero.title:
Type in your language.
The whole team reads it.
hero.subtitleBefore: Type normally in the game chat, press
hero.subtitleAfter: , and Lingo rewrites it in your teammates’ language right in the box. You just hit Enter.
hero.note: Free · No sign-up · Works right after install

features.title:
One hotkey.
The shortest path to being understood.
features.subtitle: Built for in-game team chat: copy, translate and fill back in one motion.

hotkey.title: Hotkey translation, replaced in place
hotkey.desc: Press the hotkey and the translation replaces your text in the chat box. It never sends for you; you hit Enter.

glossary.title: A glossary that knows the game
glossary.desc: Official hero, item and ability names plus player slang. BKB, smoke and rosh keep their meaning.

styles.title: Three output styles
styles.desc: Normal, Pro or Toxic. One click, and the next line uses it.

phrases.title: Phrase hotkeys
phrases.desc: Bind your frequent calls to their own shortcuts and fire them instantly.

languages.title: 9 languages, any direction
languages.desc: Chinese, English, Russian, Japanese, Korean and more.

zeroSetup.title: Works right after install
zeroSetup.desc: No account, nothing to configure, updates itself.

safe.title: Never touches the game
safe.desc: Only the OS clipboard and keyboard events. No injection, no auto-send.

styles.title: One line, three ways to say it.
styles.subtitle: Click a card to switch; the preview types out the result.

auto.title: Normal
auto.desc: Natural and easy to read, like a teammate speaking clearly.

pro.title: Pro
pro.desc: Denser terminology and shorter calls for coordinated play.

toxic.title: Toxic
toxic.tag: Use with care · may get reported
toxic.desc: Sharper and more confrontational, while staying in-game usable.
toxic.out: this trash jungler never ganks lmao
toxic.preview: jungler, mid is free, wake up lmao

howItWorks.title: Three steps. Never leave the game.
howItWorks.subtitle: The cursor never leaves the chat box.

steps.title: Press the hotkey
steps.desc: ⌘+T on macOS, Alt+T on Windows, or your own combination.

steps.title: The translation replaces your text
steps.desc: Review it, then press Enter yourself.

safety.title: Anti-cheat friendly
safety.desc: Only the OS clipboard and keyboard events. Nothing is injected into the game.

games.title:
Glossaries for four games.
Works in any other.
games.subtitle: Pick your game and translations follow its lingo. Any other game runs in generic mode.

dota2.name: Dota 2
dota2.desc: Smoke, BKB, retreat and fight calls come out the way players say them.

lol.name: League of Legends
lol.desc: Lane, jungle, objective and focus calls, phrased naturally.

overwatch.name: Overwatch
overwatch.desc: Position, focus, regroup and push calls, kept short.

wow.name: World of Warcraft
wow.desc: Raid, party and regroup messages, tidied before you send.

other.name: Other games
other.desc: Generic mode for any multiplayer game with text chat.

download.title:

windows.title: Windows
